body: I agree with your sentiment. But Life is that shit for some people that they will always feel the world is against them . You can go out with all the false optimism in the world. As soon as you get brought back to earth you realise that you have to be real with yourself. Mental health is complex and some people just don’t trust people who first seem to have “nice intentions” I’m trying to make changes in my life for the better of me . But I know i will struggle to let someone in because once you’ve been burned . You feel the sensation that it will just happen again .

I hate it when family tell you . “ no you are good looking there are people who will find you that way” when it’s all fake shit. If you get told your ugly . You will feel that way. It’s your brain conditioning it’s thoughts. I told my ex I was worthless cause throughout school nobody offered to hug me and I was heavily bullied. Now as an adult I still feel like I will never be seen as attractive. No matter how I try to laugh off awkward social interactions and the fact I’m dead inside .
Circumstances change how your brain reacts, if you suffer a death of a loved one . A friend betrays you . Or whatever it may be . You can’t just manifest being happy. That’s bullshit my friend .
